verdict.rationale: Chroma's first-party docs describe an official Chroma CLI with its own install page. The CLI can run a local server, install sample apps, browse collections and interact with Chroma Cloud DBs, and a probe confirmed the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as machine-readable output or scripting for AI workflows.
